newsitem.title: POLAND: AIB tender for WBK May 5-June 3.
newsitem.headline: AIB tender for WBK May 5-June 3.

text.p: The subscription in a public tender offer for Wielkopolski Bank Kredytowy SA (WBK) shares, announced by Allied Irish Banks Plc (AIB) on Wednesday, will take place from May 5 to June 3, WBK said in a statement.
It said Citibrokerage would carry out the subscription.

AIB, which currently has 45.7 percent of WBK but has the Polish central bank's permission to increase its stake to 60.2 percent, called a public tender offer for all listed WBK shares at 14 zlotys each.

According to an option agreement with the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development the Irish bank has the right to purchase all WBK shares held by the EBRD, which originally had 23.9 percent but last month sold 9.4 percent of WBK to AIB.
WBK's buying of all shares held by the EBRD would put its WBK holding at 60.2 percent.
